instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the opened Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run Python, bpy scripts, Text Editor scripts, Geometry Nodes exported scripts, or blender --background automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Do not install or run helper add-ons that auto-build the required result. Use only Blender native GUI tools, menus, editors, and built-in save/export commands. Collection Instances `scene.blend` already contains a collection `Gadget` with a mesh object that uses the mesh datablock `GadgetMesh`. Create three EMPTY objects named `GadgetInstance_1`, `GadgetInstance_2`, and `GadgetInstance_3`. For each one, set `instance_type = 'COLLECTION'` and `instance_collection = bpy.data.collections['Gadget']`. Place them at distinct world positions so every pair is more than `0.5` BU apart. Preserve the existing `Gadget` collection and its `GadgetMesh`, and do not duplicate mesh data: the saved file must still contain exactly one mesh datablock overall, `GadgetMesh`. Save the result as `answer.blend`.
